n = int(input())
b = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
count = 0
segmentStart = 0
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
segmentDiffs = []

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i != n - 1:
        diff = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[segmentStart])
        segmentDiffs.append(diff)
        segmentStart = i + 1
        evenCount = 0
        oddCount = 0

if len(segmentDiffs) > 0:
    segmentDiffs.sort()
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(segmentDiffs)):
        total += segmentDiffs[i]
        if total > b:
            count = i
            break
        else:
            count = i + 1
else:
    if n > 0:
        diff = abs(arr[0] - arr[0])
        if diff >= b:
            count = 1

print(count)
